# Seene by THATG33K

https://thatg33k-t33.github.io/Seene/

Generated by Seene init. Authoring guide format: 2.

From this project root, run `npx seene guide --json` and read the returned workflow and capabilities.api before authoring. That command reads this installed version's canonical guide; it owns the scene instructions and examples.

Use the installed `@thatg33k/seene` and `@thatg33k/seene/preview` exports and their TypeScript declarations for the exact API. This app's recipe directory is `src/seene/scenes`; read capabilities.api.recipes in the guide for its file contract. In a Vite host, add `seeneCreateScenePlugin()` from `@thatg33k/seene/vite` to the existing plugins array so Studio can create recipe/source pairs through the host dev server.

Tell your coding agent the desired host page route or component path, together with this file. Run `npx seene scenes --json` to inspect the app's catalog and `npx seene open --url <running-app-origin>` to open its existing dev server.
